title: NASA-UAP-VM006, Apollo 17, 1972
what_is_it: A NASA photograph from the Apollo 17 mission that is the subject of an open US Department of War (DOW) investigation into a possible UAP under the PURSUE review.
interpretation_warnings: No source text was extracted from the document; all facts derive from the war.gov CSV description and file metadata, not from the PDF body.
The investigation is open and unresolved — the 'physical object' assessment is explicitly preliminary, not a conclusion.
The document itself states there is no consensus about the nature of the anomaly.
Single-source: claims rest on the government's own case blurb; the underlying NASA/DOW analysis has not been released.

key_facts.source_quote: the accompanying NASA photograph from the Apollo 17 mission

verifiable_claims.claim: The photograph is from the Apollo 17 mission and was taken in December 1972.
